info.title: HomeChat API
info.description:
HomeChat REST API for mobile clients, Home Assistant integration, and bot webhooks.
Authentication is via Bearer token (API token) or X-API-Key header.

get.description: Returns server health status. No authentication required.
Returns server capabilities and connection info for client discovery. No authentication required.
Basic health check without authentication.
Detailed system metrics. Requires admin authentication.

post.description: Authenticate with username and password. Returns API token or 2FA challenge.
Complete two-factor authentication with temporary token and TOTP code.
Create a new user account.

201.description: User created, or created pending administrator approval

post.description: Issue a new 90-day token and deactivate the current one.

get.description: Returns all active (non-expired) tokens for the current user.

delete.description: Deactivate a specific session token belonging to the current user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile.

patch.description: Update username, timezone, or avatar. Changing username requires current password.

post.description: Change the current user's password.

get.description: Check if two-factor authentication is enabled.

post.description: Generate a new TOTP secret and provisioning URI for QR code.
Verify TOTP code and enable two-factor authentication.
Disable two-factor authentication. Requires password and TOTP code.

get.description: Retrieve 2FA backup codes. Requires TOTP verification.

post.description: Generate new 2FA backup codes. Requires TOTP verification.

put.description: Register or update the Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push notifications.

delete.description: Remove the current user's registered Firebase Cloud Messaging token.

get.description: Get messages for a channel or across all accessible channels.

post.description: Post a message to a channel (legacy endpoint for Home Assistant integration).

delete.description: Delete a message. Users can only delete their own messages (admins can delete any).

get.description: Search users, channels, and messages.
Search for users by username.
Get all non-DM channels accessible to the current user.

post.description: Create a new channel.
Create a message in a specific channel.
Upload file attachments to a channel.

422.description: E2EE channels do not support files

post.description: Join a channel.

get.description: Get members of a channel.

post.description: Mark all messages in a channel as read.

get.description: Get all DM channels for the current user.

post.description: Send a direct message to a user.
Find or create a DM channel with a user by username.

get.description: List all bots. Requires admin access.

post.description: Create a new bot. Requires admin access. Idempotent by name.

get.description: Get a bot by ID. Requires admin access.

patch.description: Update a bot. Requires admin access.

delete.description: Delete a bot. Requires admin access.

get.description: Get bot status and activity metrics. Requires admin access.

post.description: Activate a bot. Requires admin access.
Deactivate a bot. Requires admin access.
Receive webhook events from external bots. Authenticated via webhook signature.

put.description: Store the current user's encrypted HMAC key material.

get.description: Retrieve the current user's encrypted HMAC key material.

put.description: Upsert the current user's device-scoped E2EE key bundle.

get.description: Retrieve active E2EE device keys for a given user.
Returns active device key bundles for all channel members.

post.description: Accept signed encrypted channel key shares for multiple recipient devices.

get.description: Retrieve the encrypted channel key share destined for the current user's device.

post.description: Flags a channel for E2EE key rotation.

get.description: Returns the current key rotation status for the channel.

post.description: Called by a client after it has generated and distributed the new key.
